name: Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler
summary: At Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore, young druids gather water to investigate a poison killing local wildlife. The Cenarion Circle gives them empty samplers for water from the cave mouth.

sections.title: Investigating the Tainted Waters
sections.body: Cliffspring Falls feeds northern Darkshore, so trouble in its headwaters threatens the local wildlife. When a wasting poison began killing the region’s deer, Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle gave empty samplers to young druids sent from Moonglade. They must reach the cliffs by the falls and gather water at a cave entrance overrun by hostile naga.

sections.title: A Recipe for a Cure
sections.body: Alanndarian Nightsong receives the filled sampler in Auberdine. The polluted water confirms that foul agents are poisoning the water table. By studying the contamination, Alanndarian and the Cenarion druids can formulate an antidote and teach the initiate basic druidic healing rites.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this sampler?
faq.answer: Druids use the empty sampler to gather tainted water from the cave mouth at Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore. The sample helps Cenarion herbalists diagnose and cure the poison affecting local wildlife.

faq.q: Where is the water sample taken?
faq.answer: The water is gathered at the mouth of the cave near Cliffspring Falls, high in Darkshore’s northeastern hills. Hostile naga guard the entrance.
The filled sampler goes to Alanndarian Nightsong, a night elf healer and Cenarion representative in Auberdine.

faq.q: Why is Cliffspring Falls being sampled instead of other rivers?
faq.answer: Cliffspring Falls is the main freshwater source for northern Darkshore. Dendrite Starblaze traced the illness killing the region’s deer to these headwaters, so a direct sample is needed to develop a remedy.

angles.text: As a druid, you gather water at the naga-held cave as a rite of passage, then learn Cure Poison.
As a night elf, you know that naga threaten the wildlife and Auberdine by tainting Darkshore’s forest water.
